features.candidates: per decode step, the LM head's top-N token ids and softmax probabilities, taken after the full forward and before sampling
features.candidates_coverage: one record per decode row (phase 1), in the same order as the phase-1 token blocks; req_id/tok_idx are copied from that row's token block, so a batched decode step contributes one record per request in batch-row order. Prefill rows get no record: the trace's prefill rows carry no next-token distribution of their own (only the final prompt position would, and it appears as the first decode row).
features.candidates_source: lm_head logits, softmax at T=1, taken after the forward and BEFORE the sampler applies temperature/top_p/top_k; ids are vocabulary ids

clock_pair.note: globaltimer is CUDA device nanoseconds: monotonic within a run, not comparable across GPUs and not the same clock as step_wall_ns. Use this pair to align the two axes.

features.final_state: post-final-norm hidden state consumed by lm_head, stored as an extra probe with layer id 255; its hc_stream_gates/hc_lowrank are zero because no hyper-connection mix precedes it
features.hc_lowrank: activated silu(down/hc_count) vector consumed by input_mix_weight_up
features.hc_stream_gates: four exact write/injection gates 2*sigmoid(raw_inject/hc_count); the feature-wise read gate is reconstructible from hc_lowrank and checkpoint up weights
features.layer_times: per token and layer, device-clock nanoseconds at 3 points: 0 = attention + HC combine done, 1 = HC read-mix + router GEMV done, 2 = routed and shared expert compute done
features.norms: fp16 L2: router block input, summed routed output, and gated shared output
features.router_logit_storage: top32 indices plus fp16 pre-softmax logits centered by row maximum
features.top10_mass: fp16 mass under full softmax before top-10 renormalization
